北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感略热，湿度高。记得多补水！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels a bit warm and humid. Remember to hydrate!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力较大，体感凉爽。出门注意防风保暖哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has strong winds, feels cool. Take care and stay warm outside.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感闷热，湿度大。注意防暑，多喝水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels stuffy and humid. Stay cool and hydrated.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感炎热，紫外线仍强。注意防晒防暑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, feels hot, UV is still strong. Remember sun and heat protection!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感闷热，湿度高。多补水，小心热感冒。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, feels stuffy and humid. Hydrate and watch out for heat-related colds.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天风大，体感凉爽。出门小心防风，别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast with strong winds, feels cool. Be careful in the wind, don't catch a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨伴风，湿度100%。出门带伞，路滑注意安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain and wind, 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella, roads are slippery.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感偏热。阳光虽被遮挡，防晒补水仍重要！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels warm. Even with clouds, sun protection and hydration are key!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感酷热，请务必防暑！多喝水，避开高温时段。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels extremely hot, please protect from heatstroke! Hydrate and avoid peak heat.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感微热。外出注意防晒，多补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels slightly warm. Remember sun protection and hydrate well.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感闷热，湿度大。注意防暑和室内通风。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels stuffy and humid. Stay cool and ensure good indoor ventilation.
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天风大，湿度极高。出门添衣，小心着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast and windy, very high humidity. Dress warmly, avoid catching a cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，风力适中。虽体感舒适，户外活动也要注意防晒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny with moderate winds. It feels comfortable, but remember sun protection for outdoor activities.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感舒适。湿度高，出门带伞以防不时之需。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels comfortable. High humidity, bring an umbrella just in case.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力较大，体感凉爽。注意防风，海边游玩要注意安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has strong winds, feels cool. Take care in the wind, be safe if near the sea.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛小雨伴大风，体感寒凉。务必添衣保暖，注意防风防雨！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has light rain and strong winds, feels quite cold. Dress warmly, protect from wind and rain!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾且风大，能见度低。驾车慢行，注意交通安全。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and windy, visibility is low. Drive slowly and be careful on the roads.
